_comment: The model mapping: how each concept in ./source lands in DeviceChain. Edit this file, not the scripts.

unsupportedDataTypes.string: a metric must be numeric or boolean; report the value as a device attribute instead

ruleKinds.threshold: carried: threshold rule, or a duration rule when the source holds the condition for some minutes
ruleKinds.script-chain: not carried: a free-form script flow has no equivalent; rebuild it as rules plus a webhook
